name: Largest folders
description: Read-only ranking of top-level folders on C:\ by size.
rationale: Workflow pack: measure immediate C:\ subfolders without deleting or moving files.

args.command: Get-PSDrive -Name C | Select-Object Name, @{N='UsedGB';E={[math]::Round(($_.Used/1GB),2)}}, @{N='FreeGB';E={[math]::Round(($_.Free/1GB),2)}} | Format-Table | Out-String

steps.summary: Read-only: C: used and free space (GB)

args.command: $root = 'C:\'; $fso = New-Object -ComObject Scripting.FileSystemObject; $skip = @('System Volume Information','$Recycle.Bin','Recovery'); $rows = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $root -Directory -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { if ($skip -contains $_.Name) { [PSCustomObject]@{ Folder = $_.FullName; GB = $null } } else { try { [PSCustomObject]@{ Folder = $_.FullName; GB = [math]::Round(([int64]$fso.GetFolder($_.FullName).Size)/1GB, 2) } } catch { [PSCustomObject]@{ Folder = $_.FullName; GB = $null } } } }); $rows | Sort-Object GB -Descending | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String; $top = $rows | Where-Object { $null -ne $_.GB } | Sort-Object GB -Descending | Select-Object -First 1; if ($top) { "Largest top-level folder: $($top.Folder) — $($top.GB) GB" } else { 'Could not measure any folders (access denied or empty).' }

steps.summary: Read-only: size each top-level folder on C:\ (may take several minutes)
side_effects: Walks files under each top-level folder to sum sizes
